description: This file defines a generic internal class 'GenericAsyncObserver<T>' that implements 'IAsyncObserver<T>' for observing asynchronous streams with delegate-based handlers for 'OnNext', 'OnError', and 'OnCompleted' events.

classes.name: GenericAsyncObserver<T>
classes.description: An internal class implementing IAsyncObserver<T> to allow delegate-based asynchronous observation of stream events.

methods.name: OnNextAsync
methods.description: Invokes the delegate to handle the arrival of a new stream item.

methods.name: OnCompletedAsync
methods.description: Invokes the delegate to handle stream completion.

methods.name: OnErrorAsync
methods.description: Invokes the delegate to handle an error in the stream.
